metadata.title: Surface subgroups with prescribed finite quotients
metadata.abstract: We prove that every finite quotient of a finite covolume Kleinian group $G$ can be realized by a surface subgroup. More precisely, given an epimorphism from $G$ onto a finite group $F$, there exists a surface subgroup that maps surjectively onto $F$. As a consequence, the union of the surface subgroups is dense in $G$ with respect to the profinite topology. We also apply this result to obtain more examples of atoroidal surface bundles with signature zero in the construction of Kent--Leininger.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 给定有限余体积Kleinian群G及其到有限群F的满射，作者证明存在G的一个曲面子群，使该满射限制到此子群后仍满射到F。由此推出所有曲面子群的并在G的profinite拓扑中稠密，并在Kent–Leininger框架下得到更多签名为零的无环面曲面丛。
techniques: 预先指定的有限商及profinite拓扑
analysis.breakthrough: 结论从曲面子群的存在推进到给定有限商的满射实现，进而控制所有有限商所定义的profinite开集。
analysis.limitations: 群须为有限余体积Kleinian群。曲面子群可随指定满射变化，稠密性是对子群的并而言。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 第3页作者明确披露用ChatGPT检索文献、检查证明并校对稿件，分别记录literature、verification、writing。作者声明数学结果由作者发展，检查证明的披露范围限于核验。额外llm候选来自All mathematical、well-matched与will map的拼接。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.13458v1 · PDF 第3页Computational resource disclosure，全文33页。

analysis.priorityReason: 将双曲三维群的曲面子群构造与有限商及曲面丛联系起来。
